units.zh: 景宣帝
units.en: Emperor Jingxuan.
units.literal: Emperor Jingxuan.

units.zh: 景宣帝諱宗峻，本諱繩果，太祖第二子。
units.en: Emperor Jingxuan—taboo-named Zongjun, born Shengguo—was the second son of Taizu.
units.literal: Emperor Jingxuan, taboo name Zongjun, original taboo name Shengguo, was Taizu's second son.

units.zh: 母曰聖穆皇后唐括氏，太祖元妃。
units.en: His mother was Empress Shengmu of the Tangkuo clan, Taizu's chief wife.
units.literal: His mother was Empress Shengmu of the Tangkuo clan, Taizu's primary consort.

units.zh: 宗峻在諸子中最嫡。
units.en: Of all the sons, Zongjun stood first in legitimacy.
units.literal: Among all the sons, Zongjun was the most legitimate.

units.zh: 天輔五年，忽魯勃極烈杲都統諸軍取中京，帝別領合紮猛安，受金牌，既克中京，遂與杲俱襲遼主於鴛鴦濼。
units.en: In the fifth year of Tianfu, hulu bojilie Gao commanded all armies and took the Central Capital; the emperor separately led the hezha meng'an, received gold plaques, and once the Central Capital fell, together with Gao he raided the Liao ruler at Yuanyang Marsh.
units.literal: In the fifth year of Tianfu, hulu bojilie Gao commanded all armies and took the Central Capital; the emperor separately led the hezha meng'an, received gold plaques, and once the Central Capital was taken, together with Gao he raided the Liao ruler at Yuanyang Marsh.

units.zh: 遼主走陰山，耿守忠救西京，帝與宗翰等擊走之。
units.en: The Liao ruler fled to Yinshan; Geng Shouzhong came to relieve the Western Capital; the emperor with Zonghan and others struck and drove him off.
units.literal: The Liao ruler fled to Yinshan; Geng Shouzhong came to relieve the Western Capital; the emperor with Zonghan and others struck and drove him off.

units.zh: 西京城南有浮圖，敵先據之，下射，士卒多傷。
units.en: South of the Western Capital stood a pagoda; the enemy seized it first and shot downward, wounding many soldiers.
units.literal: South of the Western Capital city stood a pagoda; the enemy seized it first and shot downward, wounding many soldiers.

units.zh: 帝曰：「先取是，則西京可下。」
units.en: The emperor said: "Take that first, and the Western Capital can be taken."
units.literal: The emperor said: "Take that first, and the Western Capital can be taken."

units.zh: 既而攻浮圖，克下，遂下西京。
units.en: They then attacked the pagoda, took it, and thereafter took the Western Capital.
units.literal: They then attacked the pagoda, took it, and thereafter took the Western Capital.

units.zh: 太祖崩，帝與兄宗幹率宗室群臣立太宗。
units.en: When Taizu died, the emperor with his elder brother Zonggan led the imperial clan and ministers to install Taizong.
units.literal: When Taizu died, the emperor with his elder brother Zonggan led the imperial clan and ministers to install Taizong.

units.zh: 天會二年薨。
units.en: In the second year of Tianhui he died.
units.literal: In the second year of Tianhui he died.

units.zh: 熙宗即位，追上尊諡曰景宣皇帝，廟號徽宗。
units.en: When Xizong succeeded, Jingxuan was given the posthumous title Emperor Jingxuan and the temple name Huizong.
units.literal: When Xizong took the throne, posthumous honors were raised to Emperor Jingxuan, with temple name Huizong.

units.zh: 改葬興陵。
units.en: His tomb was moved to Xingling.
units.literal: He was reburied at Xingling.

units.zh: 海陵弑立，降熙宗為東昏王，降帝為豐王。
units.en: After Hailing murdered his way to the throne, Xizong was demoted to Prince of Eastern Darkness and Jingxuan to Prince of Feng.
units.literal: When Hailing seized the throne by murder, Xizong was reduced to Prince of Eastern Darkness and the emperor to Prince of Feng.

units.zh: 世宗複熙宗廟諡，尊帝為景宣皇帝。
units.en: Shizong restored Xizong's temple name and posthumous honors and again raised Jingxuan to emperor.
units.literal: When Shizong restored Xizong's temple title and posthumous name, the emperor was again honored as Emperor Jingxuan.

units.zh: 子合剌、常勝、查剌。
units.en: His sons were Hela, Changsheng, and Zhala.
units.literal: His sons were Hela, Changsheng, and Zhala.

units.zh: 合剌是為熙宗。
units.en: Hela was Xizong.
units.literal: Hela became Xizong.

units.zh: 睿宗立德顯仁啟聖廣運文武簡肅皇帝諱宗堯，初諱宗輔，本諱訛裏朵，大定上尊諡，追上今諱。
units.en: Ruizong—posthumously the Virtuous, Manifest, Initiating-Sagacity, Broad-Fortune, Literary-Martial, Simple-and-Solemn Emperor—was taboo-named Zongyao, first Zongfu, born Woliduo; in the Dading era his honors were raised and he received the name he bears now.
units.literal: Ruizong, posthumous title Virtuous Manifest Benevolence Initiating Sagacity Broad Fortune Literary Martial Simple Solemn Emperor, taboo name Zongyao, at first taboo name Zongfu, original taboo name Woliduo; under Dading posthumous honors were raised and his present taboo name was granted.

units.zh: 魁偉尊嚴，人望而畏之。
units.en: Massive and imposing, he made men afraid at a glance.
units.literal: Towering and august, men looked on him and feared.

units.zh: 性寬恕，好施惠，尚誠實。
units.en: He was forgiving by nature, generous in giving, and held honesty dear.
units.literal: By nature forgiving, fond of bestowing favors, and devoted to honesty.

units.zh: 太祖征伐四方，諸子皆總戎旅，帝常在帷幄。
units.en: While Taizu warred in every direction his sons led armies; the emperor himself usually kept to the command tent.
units.literal: When Taizu campaigned on every side, his sons all commanded armies, but the emperor often stayed within the command tent.

units.zh: 天輔六年，太祖親征，太宗居黃龍府，安福哥誘新降之民以叛，帝與烏古乃討平之。
units.en: In the sixth year of Tianfu, while Taizu marched in person and Taizong held Huanglong Prefecture, Anfuge stirred newly submitted folk to revolt; the emperor and Wugunai crushed them.
units.literal: In the sixth year of Tianfu, when Taizu campaigned in person and Taizong held Huanglong Prefecture, Anfuge incited newly submitted people to rebel; the emperor and Wugunai put the rising down.

units.zh: 南路軍帥鶻實答以贓敗，帝往閱實之，咸稱平允。
units.en: Southern Route commander Heshida fell to bribery; the emperor went to review the case and everyone said the ruling was just.
units.literal: Southern Route army commander Heshida was ruined by corruption; the emperor went to investigate and all called his judgment fair.

units.zh: 天會五年，宗望薨，帝為右副元帥，駐兵燕京。
units.en: In the fifth year of Tianhui Zongwang died; the emperor became right deputy commander-in-chief and stationed troops at Yanjing.
units.literal: In the fifth year of Tianhui Zongwang died; the emperor became right deputy commander-in-chief and stationed troops at Yanjing.

units.zh: 十一月，分遣諸將伐宋，帝發自河間，徇地淄、青。
units.en: In the eleventh month the generals were divided and sent against Song; the emperor set out from Hejian and pacified Zi and Qing.
units.literal: In the eleventh month the generals were divided and sent against Song; the emperor set out from Hejian and pacified Zi and Qing.

units.zh: 六年正月，宋馬括兵二十萬至樂安，帝率師擊破之。
units.en: In the first month of the sixth year Song general Ma Kuo with two hundred thousand troops reached Le'an; the emperor led his army and defeated them.
units.literal: In the first month of the sixth year Song general Ma Kuo with two hundred thousand troops reached Le'an; the emperor led his army and defeated them.

units.zh: 聞宋主在揚州，時東作方興，留大軍夾河屯田而還，軍山西。
units.en: Hearing the Song ruler was at Yangzhou and that spring planting was underway, he left the main army to farm both banks of the river and withdrew, encamping in Shanxi.
units.literal: Hearing the Song ruler was at Yangzhou and that spring planting was underway, he left the main army to farm both banks of the river and withdrew, encamping in Shanxi.

units.zh: 二月，移剌古破宋台宗雋、宋忠軍五萬於大名，明日再破之，獲宗雋、忠而還。
units.en: In the second month Yelü Gu broke fifty thousand troops of Song generals Tai Zongjun and Song Zhong at Daming; the next day he defeated them again, captured Zongjun and Zhong, and returned.
units.literal: In the second month Yelü Gu broke fifty thousand troops of Song generals Tai Zongjun and Song Zhong at Daming; the next day he defeated them again, captured Zongjun and Zhong, and returned.

units.zh: 冀州人乘夜出兵襲照裏營。
units.en: People of Jizhou by night sent troops to raid Zhaoli's camp.
units.literal: People of Jizhou by night sent troops to raid Zhaoli's camp.

units.zh: 照裏擊敗之。
units.en: Zhaoli defeated them.
units.literal: Zhaoli defeated them.

units.zh: 宋主奉表請和，密書以誘契丹、漢人。
units.en: The Song ruler submitted a memorial begging peace and sent secret letters to entice the Khitan and Han.
units.literal: The Song ruler submitted a memorial begging peace and sent secret letters to entice the Khitan and Han.

units.zh: 詔伐宋。
units.en: An edict ordered war on Song.
units.literal: An edict ordered war on Song.

units.zh: 帝發自河北，降滑州，取開德府，攻大名府，克之，河北平。
units.en: The emperor set out from Hebei, reduced Huazhou, took Kaide Prefecture, attacked Daming Prefecture, captured it, and Hebei was pacified.
units.literal: The emperor set out from Hebei, reduced Huazhou, took Kaide Prefecture, attacked Daming Prefecture, captured it, and Hebei was pacified.

units.zh: 初，伐宋，河北、河東諸將議不決，或欲先定河北、或欲先平陝西，太宗兩用其策。
units.en: Early in the war on Song, Hebei and Hedong commanders split: some wanted Hebei settled first, others Shaanxi—and Taizong followed both courses.
units.literal: At first, in the campaign against Song, the generals of Hebei and Hedong could not agree—some wished to secure Hebei first, others to pacify Shaanxi first—and Taizong used both plans.

units.zh: 而宗翰來會於濮，既平河北，遂取東平及徐州，盡得宋人江淮運致金幣在徐州官庫者，分給諸軍，而劉豫遂以濟南降。
units.en: Zonghan met him at Pu; Hebei secured, they took Dongping and Xuzhou, emptied the Song treasury of Huai–Yang gold stored at Xuzhou, shared the spoils among the hosts, and Liu Yu surrendered Jinan.
units.literal: Zonghan then joined him at Pu; once Hebei was pacified they took Dongping and Xuzhou, seized all the Song gold and coin the Huai–Yang transport had stored in Xuzhou's government vaults, divided it among the armies, and Liu Yu thereupon surrendered Jinan.

units.zh: 使拔高速等襲宋主於揚州，而宋主聞之，比拔高速至揚州，前夕已渡江矣。
units.en: Bagaosu and others were sent to make a surprise attack on the Song ruler at Yangzhou, but the Song ruler learned of it and had already crossed the Yangtze the night before Bagaosu reached Yangzhou.
units.literal: Bagaosu and others were sent to make a surprise attack on the Song ruler at Yangzhou, but the Song ruler learned of it and had already crossed the Yangtze the night before Bagaosu reached Yangzhou.

units.zh: 宋主乃貶去帝號，再以書來請存社稷，語在《宗翰傳》中，既而宗弼追宋主，宋渡江，入於杭州，複遁入海，宗弼乃還。
units.en: The Song ruler stripped his imperial title and wrote again to beg the realm be spared—the story is in Zonghan's biography; then Zongbi chased him, Song crossed the Yangtze into Hangzhou, fled to sea, and Zongbi withdrew.
units.literal: The Song ruler then cast off his imperial title and wrote again begging that the state be preserved—the account is in the biography of Zonghan; afterward Zongbi pursued the Song ruler, Song crossed the river, entered Hangzhou, then fled again to sea, and Zongbi returned.

units.zh: 於是，婁室所下陝西城邑輒叛，宗翰等曰：「前討宋，故分西師合於東軍，而陝西五路兵力雄勁，當並力攻取。
units.en: Then the Shaanxi cities Lou Shi had taken rose again, and Zonghan said, "When we first struck Song we merged the western host with the eastern army, but the five Shaanxi circuits are strong—we should strike with united force.
units.literal: Thereupon the Shaanxi towns Lou Shi had taken kept rebelling, and Zonghan and the others said: "In the earlier campaign against Song we joined the western army to the eastern host, yet the five Shaanxi circuits field fierce strength—we ought to attack together.

units.zh: 今撻懶撫定江北，宗弼以精兵二萬先往洛陽。
units.en: Tadan has pacified the country north of the river; let Zongbi march twenty thousand picked men to Luoyang first.
units.literal: Now Tadan has settled the north of the river; let Zongbi take twenty thousand elite troops first to Luoyang.

units.zh: 以八月往陝西，或使宗弼遂將以行，或宗輔、宗幹、希尹中以一人往。」
units.en: In the eighth month march on Shaanxi—either Zongbi leads the whole way, or one of Zongfu, Zonggan, and Xiyin goes."
units.literal: In the eighth month go to Shaanxi—either have Zongbi lead the army through, or send one among Zongfu, Zonggan, and Xiyin."

units.zh: 上曰：「婁室往者所向輒辦，今專征陝西，豈倦于兵而自愛邪？
units.en: The throne answered, "Lou Shi once finished whatever he undertook; set on Shaanxi alone, has he grown weary and begun to spare himself?
units.literal: The emperor said: "Lou Shi in the past accomplished whatever he aimed at; now he campaigns alone in Shaanxi—is he weary of war and sparing himself?

units.zh: 卿等其戮力焉！」
units.en: Do your utmost together!"
units.literal: You must all exert yourselves!"

units.zh: 由是詔帝往。
units.en: An edict then sent the emperor west.
units.literal: Thereupon an edict ordered the emperor to go.

units.zh: 是時，宋張浚兵取陝西，帝至洛水治兵，張浚騎兵六萬，步卒十二萬壁富平。
units.en: Song's Zhang Jun was then recovering Shaanxi; the emperor trained his men on the Luo while Zhang Jun walled Fuping with sixty thousand horse and a hundred and twenty thousand foot.
units.literal: At that time Song's Zhang Jun took Shaanxi with his army; the emperor drilled troops at the Luo River while Zhang Jun had sixty thousand horse and a hundred and twenty thousand foot entrenched at Fuping.

units.zh: 帝至富平，婁室為左翼，宗弼為右翼，兩軍並進，自日中至於昏暮，凡六合戰，破之。
units.en: At Fuping Lou Shi took the left and Zongbi the right; both wings pressed from noon to dusk, fought six rounds, and shattered Zhang Jun.
units.literal: The emperor reached Fuping; Lou Shi held the left wing and Zongbi the right; both armies advanced together from midday until dusk, fought six engagements, and broke the enemy.

units.zh: 耀州、鳳翔府皆來降。
units.en: Yaozhou and Fengxiang surrendered.
units.literal: Yaozhou and Fengxiang Prefecture both submitted.

units.zh: 遂下涇、渭二州。
units.en: Jing and Wei prefectures fell next.
units.literal: Jing and Wei prefectures were then taken.

units.zh: 敗宋經略使劉倪軍於瓦亭，原州降。
units.en: They routed Song frontier commissioner Liu Ni at Wating; Yuan Prefecture came over.
units.literal: Song frontier commissioner Liu Ni's army was defeated at Wating and Yuan Prefecture submitted.

units.zh: 撒離喝破德順軍靜邊寨，宋涇原路統制張中孚、知鎮戎軍李彥琦以城降。
units.en: Salianha broke De'an Army's Jingbian Stockade; Zhang Zhongfu, Jingyuan commander, and Li Yanqi, prefect of Zhenrong, yielded their cities.
units.literal: Salianha stormed Jingbian Stockade of De'an Army; Song Jingyuan circuit commander Zhang Zhongfu and Zhenrong Army prefect Li Yanqi surrendered their cities.

units.zh: 宋秦鳳路都統制吳玠軍於隴州境上，招討都監馬五擊走之，降一縣而還。
units.en: Wu Jie of Qinfeng held the Longzhou line; Pacification Commissioner Ma Wu beat him back, took one county, and withdrew.
units.literal: Song Qinfeng circuit commander-in-chief Wu Jie held the border at Long Prefecture; Pacification Commissioner Ma Wu struck and drove him off, reduced one county, and returned.

units.zh: 帝進兵降甘泉等三堡，取保川城，破宋熙河路副總管軍三萬，獲馬千余，拔安西等二寨，熙州降。
units.en: The emperor marched on, took three Ganquan stockades and Baochuan, shattered thirty thousand men under Song's Xihé deputy commander, seized a thousand horses and two Anxi stockades, and Xizhou submitted.
units.literal: The emperor advanced, reduced three stockades at Ganquan, took Baochuan City, broke the thirty-thousand-man army of Song's Xihé circuit deputy commander-in-chief, captured more than a thousand horses, stormed two stockades at Anxi, and Xizhou submitted.

units.zh: 分遣左翼都統阿盧補、右翼都統守弼招撫城邑之未下者，遂得鞏、洮、河、樂、西寧、蘭、廓、積石等州，定遠、和政、甘峪、甯洮、安隴等城寨及鎮堡蕃漢營部四十餘，於是涇原、熙河兩路皆平。
units.en: Alubu on the left and Shoubi on the right were sent to bring in holdouts, winning Gong, Tao, He, Le, Xining, Lan, Kuo, Jishi, Dingyuan, Hezheng, Ganyu, Ningtao, Anlong, and forty-odd Tangut and Han strongpoints until Jingyuan and Xihé were fully pacified.
units.literal: He sent Left Wing commander-in-chief Alubu and Right Wing commander-in-chief Shoubi to win over cities still holding out, and thereby gained Gong, Tao, He, Le, Xining, Lan, Kuo, and Jishi prefectures, Dingyuan, Hezheng, Ganyu, Ningtao, Anlong, and other walled towns and stockades, and more than forty Tangut and Han camps—so the Jingyuan and Xihé circuits were wholly pacified.

units.zh: 撒離喝降慶陽府，慕洧以環州降。
units.en: Salianha seized Qingyang; Mu Wei surrendered Huan Prefecture.
units.literal: Salianha took Qingyang Prefecture and Mu Wei brought Huan Prefecture over.

units.zh: 既定陝西五路，乃選騎兵六千，使撒離喝列屯沖要。
units.en: With the five Shaanxi circuits secure, six thousand horse were picked and Salianha posted them on the vital routes.
units.literal: Once the five Shaanxi circuits were settled, six thousand cavalry were chosen and Salianha stationed them at the critical passes.

units.zh: 於是班師，與宗翰俱朝京師，立熙宗為諳版勃極烈，帝為左副元帥。
units.en: They withdrew to court; with Zonghan they installed Hela as an-ban boji lie and made the emperor left deputy commander-in-chief.
units.literal: The army then withdrew; together with Zonghan he came to court, Hela was installed as an-ban boji lie, and the emperor became left deputy commander-in-chief.

units.zh: 十三年，行次媯州薨，年四十，陪葬睿陵，追封潞王，諡襄穆。
units.en: In Tianhui 13, he died while traveling through Guizhou at the age of forty. He was buried beside Ruiling and posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Lu, with the posthumous name Xiangmu.
units.literal: In Tianhui 13, he died while traveling through Guizhou, aged forty; he was buried beside Ruiling and posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Lu, with the posthumous name Xiangmu.

units.zh: 皇統六年，進冀國王。
units.en: In the sixth year of Huangtong he was raised to Prince of Ji.
units.literal: In the sixth year of Huangtong he was advanced to Prince of Ji.

units.zh: 正隆二年，追贈太師、上柱國，改封許王。
units.en: In the second year of Zhenlong he was posthumously made grand preceptor and upper pillar of state and enfeoffed as Prince of Xu.
units.literal: In the second year of Zhenlong he was posthumously made Grand Preceptor and Upper Pillar of State and enfeoffed as Prince of Xu.

units.zh: 世宗即位，追上尊諡立德顯仁啟聖廣運文武簡肅皇帝，廟號睿宗。
units.en: At Shizong's accession he received the full posthumous title and the temple name Ruizong.
units.literal: When Shizong took the throne, posthumous honors were raised to the Virtuous Manifest Benevolence Initiating Sagacity Broad Fortune Literary Martial Simple Solemn Emperor, with temple name Ruizong.

units.zh: 二年，改葬於大房山，號景陵。
units.en: In the second year his tomb was moved to Great Fang Mountain, called Jingling.
units.literal: In the second year he was reburied on Great Fang Mountain, tomb name Jingling.

units.zh: 顯宗體道弘仁英文睿德光孝皇帝，諱允恭，本諱胡土瓦，世宗第二子，母曰明德皇后烏林答氏。
units.en: Xianzong—posthumously Embodying the Way, Magnifying Benevolence, Cultured, Sagacious, Bright, and Filial—was taboo-named Yungong, born Hutuwa, Shizong's second son; his mother was Empress Mingde of the Ulinada clan.
units.literal: Xianzong, posthumous title Embodying the Way, Magnifying Benevolence, Cultured and Eloquent, Sagacious and Virtuous, Bright and Filial Emperor, taboo name Yungong, original taboo name Hutuwa, Shizong's second son; his mother was Empress Mingde of the Ulinada clan.

units.zh: 皇統六年丙寅歲生。
units.en: He was born in the sixth year of Huangtong, the bingyin year.
units.literal: He was born in the sixth year of Huangtong, the year bingyin.

units.zh: 體貌雄偉，孝友謹厚。
units.en: His frame was imposing; in filial duty and brotherhood he was careful and grave.
units.literal: In bearing he was imposing; in filial piety and brotherhood he was careful and steady.

units.zh: 大定元年十一月，世宗即位于東京。
units.en: In the eleventh month of the first year of Dading, Shizong took the throne in the Eastern Capital.
units.literal: In the eleventh month of the first year of Dading, Shizong took the throne in the Eastern Capital.

units.zh: 乙酉，封楚王，置官屬。
units.en: On yiyou he was enfeoffed as Prince of Chu and a staff was appointed.
units.literal: On yiyou he was enfeoffed as Prince of Chu and a staff was appointed.

units.zh: 十二月，從至中都。
units.en: In the twelfth month he followed him to Zhongdu.
units.literal: In the twelfth month he followed him to Zhongdu.

units.zh: 二年四月己卯，賜名允迪。
units.en: In the second year, fourth month, on jimao, he was given the name Yundi.
units.literal: Second year, fourth month, jimao: he was granted the name Yundi.

units.zh: 五月壬寅，立為皇太子，世守謂之曰：「在禮貴嫡，所以立卿。
units.en: In the fifth month, on renyin, he was installed as crown prince, and Shizong said to him, "Ritual honors the legitimate heir; that is why I have installed you.
units.literal: Fifth month, renyin: he was installed as crown prince, and Shizong told him: "Ritual honors the legitimate heir; that is why I have installed you.

units.zh: 卿友于兄弟，接百官以禮，勿以儲位生驕慢。
units.en: Love your brothers; treat officials with courtesy; do not let the crown make you proud.
units.literal: Be friendly with your brothers; receive the hundred officials with courtesy; do not let the heir's station breed arrogance.

units.zh: 日勉學問，非有召命，不須侍食。」
units.en: Work at your learning daily; unless I call you, you need not wait on my table."
units.literal: Study every day; unless summoned, you need not attend my meals."

units.zh: 帝上表謝。
units.en: The crown prince submitted a memorial of thanks.
units.literal: The crown prince submitted a memorial of thanks.

units.zh: 專心學問，與諸儒臣講議于承華殿。
units.en: He devoted himself to study and held discussions with Confucian officials in Chenghua Hall.
units.literal: He devoted himself to learning and debated with Confucian officials in Chenghua Hall.

units.zh: 燕閑觀書，乙夜忘倦，翼日輒以疑字付儒臣校證。
units.en: In his leisure he read, working past the second watch without tiring, and the next day would hand doubtful characters to Confucian officials for checking.
units.literal: In leisure he read books, forgot weariness at the second watch of night, and the next day always gave doubtful characters to Confucian officials to verify.

units.zh: 九月庚子，詔東宮三師對皇太子稱名，少師以降稱臣。
units.en: In the ninth month, on gengzi, an edict required the Eastern Palace Three Masters to address the crown prince by name and the junior master and below to call themselves his ministers.
units.literal: Ninth month, gengzi: an edict ordered the Eastern Palace Three Masters to address the crown prince by personal name, and the Junior Master and below to address him as minister.

units.zh: 十一月庚子，生辰，百官賀于承華殿，世宗賜以襲衣良馬，賜宴于仁政殿，皇族百官皆與。
units.en: On gengzi in the eleventh month, his birthday, officials congratulated him in Chenghua Hall; Shizong gave him court robes and fine horses and hosted a banquet in Renzheng Hall for the imperial clan and officials alike.
units.literal: Eleventh month, gengzi, his birthday: the hundred officials congratulated him in Chenghua Hall; Shizong bestowed court robes and fine horses and gave a banquet in Renzheng Hall, with the imperial clan and hundred officials all attending.

units.zh: 自後生辰，世宗或幸東宮，或宴內殿，歲以為常。
units.en: Thereafter on his birthdays Shizong would visit the Eastern Palace or feast in the inner halls, year after year.
units.literal: Afterward on his birthdays Shizong would either visit the Eastern Palace or banquet in the inner halls, and this became the annual custom.

units.zh: 十二月辛卯，奏曰：「東宮賀禮，親王及一品皇族皆北面拜伏，臣但答揖。
units.en: In the twelfth month, on xinmao, he memorialized: "At Eastern Palace congratulatory rites princes and first-rank clansmen all bow north prostrate, while I only return a clasped-hands bow.
units.literal: Twelfth month, xinmao, he memorialized: "In Eastern Palace congratulatory rites, princes and first-rank imperial clansmen all bow facing north prostrate, while I only return a bow with clasped hands.

units.zh: 伏望天慈聽臣答拜，庶惇親親友愛之道。」
units.en: I beg Heaven's grace to let me return bows, so kin may cherish one another."
units.literal: I humbly hope Your Heavenly Grace will allow me to return bows, that affection among kin may be deepened."

units.zh: 世宗從之，以為定制。
units.en: Shizong agreed and fixed it as precedent.
units.literal: Shizong agreed and made it a standing regulation.

units.zh: 世宗聞儒者鄭松賢，松先為同知博州防禦事致仕，起為左諭德，詔免朝參，令輔太子讀書。
units.en: Shizong heard the scholar Zheng Song was excellent; Song had retired as Bozhou defense vice commissioner, was recalled as left instructor, excused from court attendance, and told to tutor the crown prince.
units.literal: Shizong heard the Confucian Zheng Song was worthy; Song had retired as Tongzhi of Bozhou Defense Office, was recalled as Left Instructor, excused from court attendance, and ordered to assist the crown prince in reading.

units.zh: 松以友諭自處，帝嘗顧松使取服帶，松對曰：「臣忝諭德，不敢奉命。」
units.en: Song held himself as a friend-instructor; the crown prince once motioned for Song to fetch his belt, and Song said, "I am honored as instructor and dare not take such orders."
units.literal: Song treated himself as a peer instructor; the crown prince once looked to Song to fetch his belt, and Song replied: "I am honored as instructor and dare not obey such a command."

units.zh: 帝改容稱善，自是益加禮遇。
units.en: The crown prince composed himself and praised him; thereafter his courtesy only increased.
units.literal: The crown prince changed expression and praised him; from then on he was treated with still greater courtesy.

units.zh: 每出獵獲鹿，輒分賜之。
units.en: Whenever he hunted and took a deer, he would share it with Song.
units.literal: Whenever he went hunting and took a deer, he always shared it with Song.

units.zh: 四年九月，納妃徒單氏，行親迎禮。
units.en: In the fourth year, in the ninth month, he married Lady Tushi with the bride-fetching ceremony.
units.literal: Fourth year, ninth month: he took Lady Tushi as consort and performed the bride-fetching rites.

units.zh: 故事，大賀鹵簿天子乘玉路，皇太子鹵簿乘金路。
units.en: By precedent, at major celebrations the emperor's guard rode the jade chariot and the crown prince's guard the gold chariot.
units.literal: By precedent, at great felicitations the Son of Heaven's guard of honor rode the jade chariot and the crown prince's guard rode the gold chariot.

units.zh: 六年，世宗行自西京還都，禮官不知皇太子自有鹵簿金路，乃請太子就乘大駕綴路，行在天子之前。
units.en: In the sixth year, when Shizong returned from the Western Capital, ritual officials unaware that the crown prince had his own gold-chariot guard asked him to ride the imperial procession's trailing section ahead of the emperor on the road.
units.literal: In the sixth year, as Shizong returned from the Western Capital to the capital, the ritual officials did not know the crown prince had his own guard and gold chariot and asked the prince to take the great imperial procession's trailing road ahead of the Son of Heaven on the journey.

units.zh: 上疑其非禮，詳閱舊典，禮官始覺其誤。
units.en: The emperor suspected this breached ritual, scrutinized the old codes, and the ritual officials only then saw their mistake.
units.literal: The emperor doubted this was improper, closely reviewed the old regulations, and the ritual officials then realized their error.

units.zh: 於是禮部郎中李邦直、員外郎李山削一階，太常少卿武之才、太常丞張子羽、博士張榘削兩階。
units.en: Director in the Ministry of Rites Li Bangzhi and Vice Director Li Shan were demoted one grade; Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Wu Zhicai, Assistant Director Zhang Ziyu, and Erudite Zhang Ju were demoted two grades.
units.literal: Thereupon Director in the Ministry of Rites Li Bangzhi and Vice Director Li Shan were demoted one grade; Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Wu Zhicai, Assistant Director Zhang Ziyu, and Erudite Zhang Ju were demoted two grades.

units.zh: 頃之，禮官議受冊謁謝太廟，服常朝服，乘馬，世宗曰：「此與外宮禮上後謁諸神廟無異，海陵一時率意行之，何足為法？
units.en: Soon ritual officials proposed that receiving the seal and thanking the ancestral temple be done in regular court dress on horseback; Shizong said, "That matches nothing but an elevated consort's visit to spirit shrines; Hailing did it on impulse—how is that a model?
units.literal: Soon the ritual officials proposed that on receiving the seal and bowing in thanks at the ancestral temple he wear regular court dress and ride a horse; Shizong said: "This is no different from the rites by which outer consorts after elevation visit the spirit temples; Hailing followed his whim for a time—how can that be a model?

units.zh: 大冊與三歲祫享當用古禮為是。
units.en: A great investiture and the triennial tu sacrifice should follow the ancient rites.
units.literal: Great investiture and the triennial tu sacrifice ought to follow ancient rites.

units.zh: 孔子曰：'禮與其奢也寧儉。
units.en: Confucius said, 'In ritual, better be spare than lavish.'
units.literal: Confucius said, 'In ritual, better spare than be lavish.'

units.zh: '不當輕易如此。」
units.en: It should not be done so lightly."
units.literal: One should not lightly do it this way."

units.zh: 又曰：「右丞蘇保衡雖漢人不通經史，參政石琚通經史而不言，前日禮官既已削奪，猶不懼邪？
units.en: He added, "Right Vice Director Su Baoheng, a Han man, knows no classics; Participating Councillor Shi Ju knows them yet stays silent; ritual officers were demoted only yesterday—are you still unafraid?
units.literal: He also said: "Right Vice Director Su Baoheng, though a Han man, does not know the classics and histories; Participating Councillor Shi Ju knows them yet says nothing; the ritual officials were demoted the other day—are you still not afraid?

units.zh: 其具前代典禮以聞，朕將擇而處之。」
units.en: Compile former dynasties' ritual codes and report; I will choose among them."
units.literal: Compile the ceremonial codes of former dynasties and report; I shall choose and act."

units.zh: 久之，將授太子冊寶，儀注備儀仗告太廟。
units.en: Later, as the crown prince's seal and treasure were to be conferred, the prescribed rites with full guards were announced at the ancestral temple.
units.literal: After a long interval, when the crown prince's seal and treasure were to be conferred, the ritual regulations with full guards of honor reported to the ancestral temple.

units.zh: 上曰：「朕受尊號謁謝，乃用故宋真宗故事，常朝服乘馬。
units.en: The emperor said, "When I received my honored title and thanked the temple, I followed former Song Emperor Zhenzong—regular court dress on horseback.
units.literal: The emperor said: "When I received my honored title and bowed in thanks, I used the former Song Emperor Zhenzong's precedent—regular court dress on horseback.

units.zh: 皇太子乃用備禮，前後不稱，甚無謂也。」
units.en: The crown prince is given full ceremony; the two do not match—what sense is there?"
units.literal: The crown prince is to use full ceremonial rites; before and after do not match—how pointless."

units.zh: 謂右丞相良弼、左丞守道曰：「此卿等不用心所致。」
units.en: He told Right Grand Councillor Liangbi and Left Vice Director Shoudao, "This is because you were inattentive."
units.literal: He said to Right Grand Councillor Liangbi and Left Vice Director Shoudao: "This comes from your lack of attention."

units.zh: 良弼等謝曰：「臣愚慮不及此。」
units.en: Liangbi and the others apologized, "Our short-sightedness never reached this."
units.literal: Liangbi and the others apologized: "Our foolish consideration did not reach this."

units.zh: 上複曰：「此文臣因循故也。」
units.en: The emperor added, "Civil officials simply follow routine."
units.literal: The emperor again said: "This is because civil officials follow precedent."

units.zh: 是年十月甲申，祫享於太廟，行亞獻禮。
units.en: That year, on jiashen in the tenth month, he performed the secondary offering at the ancestral temple's tu sacrifice.
units.literal: That year, tenth month, jiashen: tu sacrifice at the ancestral temple; he performed the secondary offering rite.

units.zh: 七年，帝有疾，詔左丞守道侍湯藥，徙居瓊林苑臨芳殿調治。
units.en: In the seventh year the crown prince fell ill; Shoudao was ordered to tend his medicine, and he moved to Linfang Hall in Qionlin Garden to recuperate.
units.literal: In the seventh year the crown prince fell ill; an edict ordered Left Vice Director Shoudao to attend his medicine, and he moved to Linfang Hall in Qionlin Garden for treatment.

units.zh: 八年正月甲戌，改賜名允恭。
units.en: In the eighth year, on jiaxu in the first month, he was renamed Yungong.
units.literal: Eighth year, first month, jiaxu: his given name was changed to Yungong.

units.zh: 庚辰，受皇太子冊寶，帝上表謝。
units.en: On gengchen he received the crown prince's seal and treasure and submitted a memorial of thanks.
units.literal: On gengchen he received the crown prince's seal and treasure, and the crown prince submitted a memorial of thanks.

units.zh: 九年五月，世宗命避暑於草濼，隋王惟功從行，其應從行者皆給道路費。
units.en: In the fifth month of the ninth year Shizong sent him to escape the heat at Caoliao; Prince of Sui Weigong went along, and every attendant was given road money.
units.literal: Ninth year, fifth month: Shizong ordered him to escape the heat at Caoliao; Prince of Sui Weigong accompanied him, and all who were to accompany him were given travel expenses.

units.zh: 帝奏曰：「遠去闕廷，獨就涼地，非臣子所安，願罷行。」
units.en: The crown prince memorialized, "Leaving court for a cool place alone is no comfort for a subject; I ask that the trip be canceled."
units.literal: The crown prince memorialized: "To go far from the court and alone to a cool place is not what a subject should find ease in; I beg that the journey be canceled."

units.zh: 世宗曰：「汝體羸弱，山后高涼，故命汝往。」
units.en: Shizong said, "You are frail; the high country behind the mountains is cool, so I sent you there."
units.literal: Shizong said: "Your body is frail; the mountains behind are high and cool, so I ordered you to go."

units.zh: 丁丑，百官奉辭於都城之北，再拜，帝答拜。
units.en: On dingchou officials bade farewell north of the capital; they bowed twice and the crown prince bowed in return.
units.literal: On dingchou the hundred officials bade farewell north of the capital; they bowed twice and the crown prince returned the bows.

units.zh: 是月，百官承詔具箋問起居。
units.en: That month, by edict, officials prepared memorials asking after his health.
units.literal: That month the hundred officials, per edict, prepared memorials inquiring after his health.

units.zh: 六月，百官問起居如前。
units.en: In the sixth month officials inquired after his health as before.
units.literal: Sixth month: the hundred officials inquired after his health as before.

units.zh: 八月乙酉，至自草濼，百官迎謁於都城之北，如送儀。
units.en: On yiyou in the eighth month he returned from Caoliao; officials welcomed him north of the capital with the same rites as at his departure.
units.literal: Eighth month, yiyou: he returned from Caoliao; the hundred officials welcomed and saluted him north of the capital, following the farewell ceremony.

units.zh: 丙戌，入見，世宗曰：「吾兒相別經夏，極甚思憶也。」
units.en: On bingxu he was received in audience; Shizong said, "My son, a whole summer apart—I have missed you sorely."
units.literal: On bingxu he had an audience; Shizong said: "My son, we have been apart a whole summer—I have missed you deeply."

units.zh: 九月，詔皇太子供膳勿月支，歲給五千萬。
units.en: In the ninth month an edict ended monthly kitchen payments to the crown prince and granted him fifty million a year.
units.literal: Ninth month: an edict ordered that the crown prince's meals not be disbursed monthly and that fifty million be granted yearly.

units.zh: 十年八月，帝在承華殿經筵，太子太保壽王爽啟曰：「殿下頗未熟本朝語，何不屏去左右漢官，皆用女直人。」
units.en: In the eighth month of the tenth year, while the crown prince attended a classics lecture in Chenghua Hall, Shuang, Prince of Shou and Grand Guardian of the Crown Prince, said, "Your Highness is still weak in our tongue—why not dismiss the Han officials around you and use only Jurchens?"
units.literal: Tenth year, eighth month: the crown prince was at the classics lecture in Chenghua Hall when Crown Prince Grand Guardian Prince Shou Shuang memorialized: "Your Highness is still not fluent in our dynasty's language—why not dismiss the Han officials at your side and use only Jurchens?"

units.zh: 帝曰：「諭德、贊善及侍從官，曷敢輒去？」
units.en: The crown prince said, "Instructors, aides, and attendants—how dare I dismiss them on a whim?"
units.literal: The crown prince said: "The instructors, aides, and attendants—how dare I remove them at will?"

units.zh: 爽乃揖而退。
units.en: Shuang bowed and withdrew.
units.literal: Shuang bowed and withdrew.

units.zh: 帝曰：「宮官四員謂之諭德、贊善，義可見矣，而反欲去之，無學故也。」
units.en: The crown prince said, "Four palace officers are called instructors and aides—the point is obvious—yet you would remove them; you lack learning."
units.literal: The crown prince said: "The four palace officers are called instructors and aides—the meaning is plain—yet you would remove them; it is because you are unlearned."

units.zh: 有使者自山東還，帝問民間何所苦，使者曰：「錢難最苦。
units.en: A messenger returned from Shandong; the crown prince asked what troubled the people most, and he said, "Scarce cash is the worst hardship.
units.literal: A messenger returned from Shandong; the crown prince asked what the people found hardest, and the messenger said: "The shortage of cash is the worst hardship.

units.zh: 官庫錢滿有露積者，而民間無錢，以此苦之。」
units.en: Treasury coin overflowed and lay heaped in the open, yet commoners had none—that is their hardship."
units.literal: Treasury cash was full and some lay piled in the open, yet the people had no cash—that is why they suffered."

units.zh: 帝曰：「貯之空室，雖多奚為。」
units.en: The crown prince said, "Hoarding it in empty rooms—of what use is plenty?"
units.literal: The crown prince said: "Storing it in empty rooms—what good is abundance?"

units.zh: 謂戶部尚書張仲愈曰：「天子富藏天下，何必獨在府庫也。」
units.en: He told Minister of Revenue Zhang Zhongyu, "The Son of Heaven is rich when the realm is stored up—why keep it all in the treasury alone?"
units.literal: He said to Minister of Revenue Zhang Zhongyu: "The Son of Heaven's wealth lies in storing up the realm—why must it all sit in the treasury?"

units.zh: 因奏曰：「錢在府庫，何異銅礦在野。
units.en: He then submitted, "Treasury cash is no different from copper ore left in the open country.
units.literal: He then memorialized: "Money in the treasury—how is it different from copper ore left in the wild?

units.zh: 乞流轉，使公私俱利。」
units.en: I ask that it be put into circulation for the benefit of both state and people."
units.literal: I beg that it be circulated, so that public and private interests alike may profit."

units.zh: 世宗嘉納，詔有司議行之。
units.en: Shizong commended the proposal and ordered the offices to consider implementing it.
units.literal: Shizong approved and ordered the responsible offices to deliberate and carry it out.

units.zh: 十年一月丁亥，有事於圓丘，帝行亞獻禮。
units.en: In the tenth year, first month, on dinghai, rites were held at the Circular Mound and the Heir made the sub-offering.
units.literal: Tenth year, first month, dinghai: rites were performed at the Circular Mound; the Heir performed the sub-offering.

units.zh: 十二年五月，世宗聞德州防禦使胡剌謀叛，因曰：「朕於親親之道未嘗不篤，而輒敢如此。」
units.en: In the twelfth year, fifth month, Shizong heard De Prefecture defensive commissioner Hu La was plotting rebellion and said, "I have always held to kinship—how dare he act like this?"
units.literal: Twelfth year, fifth month: Shizong heard that Defensive Commissioner of De Prefecture Hu La plotted rebellion and said: "In the Way of kinship I have never been remiss—how dare he so conduct himself?"

units.zh: 帝徐奏曰：「叔胡剌性荒縱，耽娛樂，而無子嗣，忽如此狂謀，望更閱實之。」
units.en: The Heir submitted quietly, "Uncle Hu La is wild and dissipated, devoted to pleasures, and childless—such a rash plot is sudden; I beg the matter be checked again."
units.literal: The Heir slowly memorialized: "Uncle Hu La is by nature dissolute and extravagant, addicted to pleasure, and without heirs—suddenly such a mad plot; I hope it may be reviewed again for verification."

units.zh: 十月己未，祫享於太廟，帝攝行祀事。
units.en: In the tenth month, on jiwei, a united sacrifice was held at the Grand Temple and the Heir presided over the rites.
units.literal: Tenth month, jiwei: united sacrifice at the Grand Temple; the Heir acted in proxy to conduct the rites.

units.zh: 十三年十月，承詔與趙王惟中、曹王惟功獵於保州、定州。
units.en: In the tenth month of the thirteenth year, by edict he hunted with Weizhong, Prince of Zhao, and Weigong, Prince of Cao, in Bao and Ding prefectures.
units.literal: Thirteenth year, tenth month: by imperial order he hunted with Weizhong, Prince of Zhao, and Weigong, Prince of Cao, in Bao and Ding prefectures.

units.zh: 十一月甲午，還京師。
units.en: In the eleventh month, on jiawu, he returned to the capital.
units.literal: Eleventh month, jiawu: he returned to the capital.

units.zh: 十四年四月乙亥，世宗禦垂拱殿，帝及諸王侍側。
units.en: In the fourteenth year, fourth month, on yihai, Shizong held audience at the Chui Gong Hall with the Heir and the princes in attendance.
units.literal: Fourteenth year, fourth month, yihai: Shizong held court at the Chui Gong Hall; the Heir and the princes attended at his side.

units.zh: 世宗論及兄弟妻子之際，世宗曰：「婦言是聽而兄弟相違，甚哉。」
units.en: Shizong spoke of brothers and wives and said, "To heed a wife's words and part from one's brothers—how far it goes!"
units.literal: Shizong discussed the relations between brothers and wives; Shizong said: "To heed a wife's words and turn from one's brothers—how extreme!"

units.zh: 帝對曰：「《思齊》之詩曰：'刑于寡妻，至於兄弟，以禦於家邦。
units.en: The Heir answered, "In the 'Si Qi' it is said, 'Be a model to your chief wife, reach your brothers, and thereby govern family and state.'
units.literal: The Heir replied: "The Odes' 'Si Qi' says: 'Setting an example for one's wife, extending to brothers, thereby governing family and state.'

units.zh: '臣等愚昧，願相勵而修之。」
units.en: We are ignorant, but we wish to urge one another to live by it."
units.literal: We your subjects are dull and wish to encourage one another in practicing this."

units.zh: 因引《棠棣》華萼相承，脊令急難之義，為文見意，以誡兄弟焉。
units.en: He then drew on the 'Tang Di' theme of flower and calyx sustaining one another and the jiling bird's call in hardship, and wrote an essay for his brothers admonishing kinship.
units.literal: He then cited the meanings of 'Tang Di'—flower and calyx mutually sustaining, and the jiling bird in urgent difficulty—and wrote an essay expressing his intent to admonish his brothers.

units.zh: 十五年，世宗詔五品職事官謝見皇太子。
units.en: In the fifteenth year Shizong ordered fifth-rank officeholders to pay their respects to the Crown Prince.
units.literal: Fifteenth year: Shizong ordered fifth-rank duty officials to present thanks and audience to the Crown Prince.

units.zh: 十七年五月甲辰，侍宴于常武殿，典食令涅合進粥，帝將食，有蜘蛛在粥碗中，涅合恐懼失措，帝從容曰：「蜘蛛吐絲乘空，忽墮此中爾，豈汝罪哉。」
units.en: In the seventeenth year, fifth month, on jiachen, at a feast in the Changwu Hall, Food Service director Niehe served porridge; as the Heir was about to eat, a spider sat in the bowl; Niehe panicked; the Heir said calmly, "The spider spun its thread and drifted down—how is that your fault?"
units.literal: Seventeenth year, fifth month, jiachen: attending a feast in the Changwu Hall, Food Service director Niehe brought porridge; as the Heir was about to eat, a spider was in the bowl; Niehe was terrified and lost composure; the Heir calmly said: "The spider spun silk and rode the air, then suddenly fell into this—how is it your fault?"

units.zh: 十月己卯，祫享於太廟，攝行祀事。
units.en: In the tenth month, on jimao, united sacrifice at the Grand Temple; he again conducted the rites.
units.literal: Tenth month, jimao: united sacrifice at the Grand Temple; he presided over the rites in proxy.

units.zh: 十九年四月戊申，有事於太廟，攝行祀事。
units.en: In the nineteenth year, fourth month, on wushen, rites were held at the Grand Temple and he presided.
units.literal: Nineteenth year, fourth month, wushen: rites at the Grand Temple; he conducted them in proxy.

units.zh: 丁巳，詹事烏林答願入謝，帝命取襆頭腰帶，官屬請曰：「此見宰相師傅之禮也。」
units.en: On dingsi, Heir Apparent Household Manager Wulinada Yuan came to give thanks; the Heir had his formal cap and belt fetched; his staff said, "That is the ceremony for seeing the chief minister and tutor."
units.literal: Dingsi, Household Manager of the Heir Wulinada Yuan came to give thanks; the Heir ordered his formal cap and belt brought; the staff pleaded: "These are the rites for audience with the chief minister and tutor."

units.zh: 帝曰：「願事陛下久，以此加敬耳。」
units.en: The Heir said, "Yuan has served Your Majesty long—I show extra respect for that alone."
units.literal: The Heir said: "Yuan has served Your Majesty long; I show added respect for that reason alone."

units.zh: 皆曰：「非臣等所及。」
units.en: All said, "Beyond what your subjects would do."
units.literal: All said: "Not something your subjects could match."

units.zh: 十一月，改葬明德皇后于坤厚陵，帝徒行挽靈車。
units.en: In the eleventh month Empress Mingde was moved to Kunhou Tomb; the Heir walked on foot and drew the spirit carriage.
units.literal: Eleventh month: Empress Mingde was reinterred at Kunhou Tomb; the Heir walked on foot drawing the spirit carriage.

units.zh: 遇大風雪，左右進雨具，帝卻之。
units.en: A great wind and snow struck; attendants offered rain gear; the Heir declined it.
units.literal: He met a great wind and snow; attendants offered rain gear; the Heir refused it.

units.zh: 比至頓所，衣盡沾濕，觀者無不下淚。
units.en: When he reached the overnight lodge his clothes were soaked through, and onlookers wept.
units.literal: By the time he reached the halting place, his clothes were wholly soaked; onlookers all wept.

units.zh: 海陵雖貶黜為庶人，宗幹尚稱明肅皇帝，議者以為未盡，帝具表奏論。
units.en: Though Hailing had been reduced to commoner rank, Zonggan was still called Emperor Mingsu; critics said this went too far; the Heir memorialized at length on the matter.
units.literal: Though Hailing was degraded to commoner status, Zonggan was still styled Emperor Mingsu; discussants thought this incomplete; the Heir submitted a full memorial arguing the point.

units.zh: 世宗嘉納之。
units.en: Shizong accepted the argument.
units.literal: Shizong approved it.

units.zh: 於是宗幹削去帝號，降封遼王。
units.en: Zonggan then lost the imperial title and was demoted to Prince of Liao.
units.literal: Thereupon Zonggan was stripped of the imperial title and demoted to Prince of Liao.

units.zh: 二十四年，世宗將幸上京，詔帝守國，作「守國之寶」以授之。
units.en: In the twenty-fourth year Shizong was going to the Upper Capital; he ordered the Heir to keep the realm and cast a "Treasure for Guarding the Realm" to give him.
units.literal: Twenty-fourth year: Shizong was to visit the Upper Capital; he ordered the Heir to guard the realm and made a "Treasure for Guarding the Realm" to confer on him.

units.zh: 其遣使、祭享、五品以上官及事利害重者遣使馳奏，六品以下官、其餘常事，並聽裁決。
units.en: He might send envoys and order sacrifices; for fifth-rank officers and grave issues he was to dispatch urgent memorials; sixth-rank and lesser officers and routine business he might decide himself.
units.literal: As for dispatching envoys, sacrifices, fifth-rank-and-above officials, and matters of serious benefit or harm—envoys were to be sent with urgent memorial; sixth-rank-and-below officials and other routine affairs were all left to his judgment.

units.zh: 每三日一次於集賢殿受尚書省啟事。
units.en: Every three days he once received the Masters of Writing's business at the Jixian Hall.
units.literal: Every three days once, at the Jixian Hall, he received reports from the Masters of Writing.

units.zh: 京朝官遇朔望具朝服問侯。
units.en: Capital officials on the first and fifteenth of the month wore court dress to inquire after him.
units.literal: Capital court officials on new and full moon wore full court dress to inquire after his health.

units.zh: 車駕在路，每二十日一遣使問起居。
units.en: While the emperor was on the road, an envoy inquired after him every twenty days.
units.literal: While the imperial carriage was on the road, every twenty days an envoy was sent to inquire after his health.

units.zh: 已達上京，每三十日一問起居。
units.en: After the Upper Capital was reached, inquiries came every thirty days.
units.literal: Once the Upper Capital was reached, every thirty days one's health was inquired after.

units.zh: 世宗曰：「今巡幸或能留一二年，以汝守國。
units.en: Shizong said, "This tour may keep me a year or two—you will keep the realm.
units.literal: Shizong said: "This tour may keep me one or two years; you are to guard the realm.

units.zh: 譬之農家種田，商人營利，但能不墜父業。
units.en: Like a farmer planting fields or a merchant seeking profit—only do not let your father's work fail.
units.literal: It is like a farming household planting fields or a merchant seeking profit—so long as you do not let your father's enterprise fall.

units.zh: 即為克家子也。」
units.en: Then you are a son who can uphold the house."
units.literal: Then you are a son who can sustain the family."

units.zh: 帝對曰：「臣在東宮二十餘年，過失甚多，陛下以明德皇后之故未嘗見責。
units.en: The Heir answered, "I have been in the Eastern Palace over twenty years with many faults; for Empress Mingde's sake Your Majesty has never blamed me.
units.literal: The Heir replied: "Your subject has been in the Eastern Palace more than twenty years with many faults; because of Empress Mingde Your Majesty has never reproached me.

units.zh: 臣誠愚昧，不克負荷，乞備扈從。」
units.en: I am truly dull and cannot bear the load; I beg to go in attendance."
units.literal: Your subject is truly dull and cannot bear the burden; I beg to join the entourage."

units.zh: 世宗曰：「凡人養子，皆望投老得力。
units.en: Shizong said, "When ordinary men raise a son, they all hope he will be useful in old age.
units.literal: Shizong said: "When ordinary men raise a son, they all hope that in old age he will prove useful.

units.zh: 朕留太尉、左右丞、參政輔汝，彼皆國家舊人，可與商議。
units.en: I leave the Grand Marshal, the left and right vice directors, and the participation councillors to help you—they are old servants of the state and you may consult them.
units.literal: I leave the Grand Marshal, left and right vice directors, and participation councillors to assist you—they are all old servants of the state and may be consulted.

units.zh: 且政事無難，但用心公正，無納讒邪，一月之後，政事自熟。」
units.en: Government is not hard—only be fair, take no slander, and after a month you will know the work."
units.literal: Moreover government is not difficult: only be just in heart, admit no slander, and after a month affairs will come naturally."

units.zh: 帝流涕堅辭，左右為之感動。
units.en: The Heir wept and firmly refused; those beside him were moved.
units.literal: The Heir wept and steadfastly declined; those beside him were moved.

units.zh: 三月，世宗如上京，帝守國留中都。
units.en: In the third month Shizong went to the Upper Capital; the Heir kept the realm and stayed at Zhongdu.
units.literal: Third month: Shizong went to the Upper Capital; the Heir guarded the realm and remained at Zhongdu.

units.zh: 初，帝在東宮，或攜中侍步于芳苑。
units.en: Before, in the Eastern Palace, the Heir would sometimes walk in the Fragrant Garden with palace attendants.
units.literal: Earlier, while in the Eastern Palace, the Heir would sometimes take palace attendants walking in the Fragrant Garden.

units.zh: 中侍出入禁中，未嘗限阻。
units.en: Palace attendants had never been barred from coming and going in the inner palace.
units.literal: Palace attendants entering and leaving the forbidden precinct had never been restricted.

units.zh: 此輩見帝守國，各為得意，帝知之，謂諸中侍曰：「我向在東宮，不親國政，日與汝輩語話。
units.en: Seeing him keep the realm, the attendants grew bold; the Heir knew it and told them, "When I was in the Eastern Palace I did not touch government and spent my days in talk with you.
units.literal: When these people saw the Heir guarding the realm, each grew self-satisfied; the Heir knew it and said to the palace attendants: "Before, in the Eastern Palace, I did not handle state affairs and passed the days talking with you.

units.zh: 今即守國，汝等有召命然後得入。」
units.en: Now that I keep the realm, you may enter only when summoned."
units.literal: Now that I guard the realm, you may enter only when summoned."

units.zh: 五月，世宗至上京，賜敕書曰：「朕以前月八日到遼陽，此月二日達上京，翌日祀慶元廟。
units.en: In the fifth month Shizong reached the Upper Capital and sent an edict: "We reached Liaoyang on the eighth of last month and the Upper Capital on the second of this month; the next day we sacrificed at Qingyuan Temple.
units.literal: Fifth month: Shizong reached the Upper Capital and granted an imperial letter: "We reached Liaoyang on the eighth of last month, reached the Upper Capital on the second of this month, and on the morrow sacrificed at Qingyuan Temple.

units.zh: 省方觀民，古之制也。
units.en: Inspecting the realm and watching over the people is the ancient way.
units.literal: Touring the regions to observe the people—this is the ancient institution.

units.zh: 汝守國任重，夏暑方熾，益當自愛，無貽朕憂。」
units.en: You bear heavy responsibility as regent; summer heat is fierce — take still greater care of yourself and spare me worry."
units.literal: You bear heavy duty keeping the realm; summer heat is fierce — take still greater care of yourself and give Us no cause for worry."

units.zh: 帝謂徒單克寧曰：「車駕巡幸，以國事見屬。
units.en: The emperor told Tudan Kening: "While the carriage is away, state affairs rest with me.
units.literal: The emperor said to Tudan Kening: "The imperial carriage is on tour and state affairs have been entrusted to me.

units.zh: 刑名最重，人之死生系焉。
units.en: Criminal justice is the weightiest matter — lives hang upon it.
units.literal: Criminal law is weightiest; human life and death hang upon it.

units.zh: 凡有可議，當盡至公。
units.en: Whatever may be disputed must be judged with full impartiality.
units.literal: Whenever there is room for debate, you must be utterly impartial.

units.zh: 比主上還都，勿有廢事。」
units.en: Until the sovereign returns, let no business lapse."
units.literal: Before the sovereign returns to the capital, let nothing in office lapse."

units.zh: 自是，凡啟稟刑名，帝自披閱，召都事委曲折正，移晷忘倦，或賜之食。
units.en: Thereafter, on every criminal report the emperor read the papers himself, called the chief clerk to trace each point, and worked past fatigue — sometimes even sending food.
units.literal: From then on, whenever criminal matters were reported, the emperor himself unrolled the documents, summoned the chief clerk to settle each twist and turn, and forgot fatigue as the day wore on — sometimes even bestowing food.

units.zh: 近侍報瑤池位蓮開，當設宴。
units.en: Attendants reported lotus in bloom at the Jade Pool and urged a banquet.
units.literal: Attendants reported that lotus had bloomed at the Jade Pool site and a banquet should be set.

units.zh: 帝曰：「聖上東巡，命我守國，何敢宴遊廢事？
units.en: The emperor said: "The sovereign tours east and left me to keep the realm — how dare I feast and neglect duty?
units.literal: The emperor said: "The sovereign is touring east and charged me to keep the realm — how dare I feast and neglect duty?

units.zh: 采致數花足矣。」
units.en: A few blossoms gathered will do."
units.literal: Gathering a few blossoms is enough."

units.zh: 七月，遣子金源郡王麻達葛奉表問起居，請世宗還都。
units.en: In the seventh month he sent his son, Prince of Jinyuan Madage, with a memorial inquiring after the emperor’s health and begging his return.
units.literal: Seventh month: he sent his son, Prince of Jinyuan Madage, with a memorial to inquire after health and beg Shizong to return to the capital.

units.zh: 十一月壬寅，帝冬獵。
units.en: In the eleventh month, on renyin, the emperor held a winter hunt.
units.literal: Eleventh month, on renyin, the emperor winter-hunted.

units.zh: 辛亥，還都。
units.en: On xinhai he returned to the capital.
units.literal: On xinhai he returned to the capital.

units.zh: 二十五年正月乙酉朔，免群臣賀禮。
units.en: In the twenty-fifth year, first month, on the yiyou new moon, officials were excused from congratulatory rites.
units.literal: Twenty-fifth year, first month, on yiyou new moon: congratulatory rites for the officials were waived.

units.zh: 帝自守國，深懷謙抑，宮臣不庭拜，啟事時不侍立，免朔望禮。
units.en: Since taking responsibility for the realm, the heir was deeply modest: palace officers did not make court obeisance to him, and he did not require them to stand in attendance when presenting matters; new-moon and full-moon audiences were waived.
units.literal: Since taking responsibility for the realm, the heir was deeply modest: palace officers did not make court obeisance to him, and he did not require them to stand in attendance when presenting matters; the new-moon and full-moon rites were waived.

units.zh: 京朝朔日當具公服問候，並停免。
units.en: Capital officials’ new-moon appearances in court dress to inquire after him were also stopped.
units.literal: Capital officials on new-moon days were to appear in full dress to inquire — that too was stopped.

units.zh: 至是，群臣當賀，亦不肯受。
units.en: When officials would have congratulated him, he still refused.
units.literal: When officials would have congratulated him, he still refused.

units.zh: 甲寅，帝如春水。
units.en: On jiayin the emperor went to the spring waters.
units.literal: On jiayin the emperor went to the spring waters.

units.zh: 二月庚申，還都。
units.en: In the second month, on gengshen, he returned to the capital.
units.literal: Second month, on gengshen, he returned to the capital.

units.zh: 丁卯，遣子金源郡王麻達葛奉表賀萬春節。
units.en: On dingmao he sent Prince of Jinyuan Madage with a memorial congratulating the Wan Spring Festival.
units.literal: On dingmao he sent his son, Prince of Jinyuan Madage, with a memorial congratulating the Wan Spring Festival.

units.zh: 四月，久不雨，帝親禱，即日沾足。
units.en: In the fourth month, after prolonged drought, the emperor prayed in person and rain came the same day.
units.literal: Fourth month: after long drought the emperor prayed in person and rain was sufficient that very day.

units.zh: 六月甲寅，帝不豫。
units.en: In the sixth month, on jiayin, the emperor fell ill.
units.literal: Sixth month, on jiayin, the emperor fell ill.

units.zh: 庚申，崩于承華殿。
units.en: On gengshen he died in Chenghua Hall.
units.literal: On gengshen he died in Chenghua Hall.

units.zh: 世宗自上京還，次天平山好水川，訃聞，為位臨奠于行宮之南，大慟者久之。
units.en: Shizong was returning from the Upper Capital and halted at Tianping Mountain on the Haoshui; on the death report he set a mourning seat south of the traveling palace and wept long.
units.literal: Shizong was returning from the Upper Capital and halted at Tianping Mountain on the Haoshui River; when the death report came, he set up a mourning seat south of the traveling palace and lamented long.

units.zh: 親王、百官、皇族、命婦及侍衛皆會哭，世宗號泣還宮。
units.en: Princes, officials, the clan, consorts, and guards all gathered to weep; Shizong wailed and returned within.
units.literal: Princes, officials, the imperial clan, titled consorts, and guards all gathered to weep; Shizong wailed and returned to the palace.

units.zh: 比至中都，為位奠哭者凡七焉。
units.en: By the time he reached the Central Capital he had mourned and wept seven times.
units.literal: By the time he reached the Central Capital he had set mourning seats and wept seven times.

units.zh: 世宗以豳王永成為中都留守，來護喪，遣滕王府長史再興、禦院通進阿裏剌來保護金源郡王，遣左宣徽使唐括鼎來致祭，詔妃徒單氏及諸皇孫喪服並如漢制。
units.en: Shizong appointed Yongcheng, Prince of Bin, as Stay-behind of the Central Capital, and he came to supervise the mourning. He sent Zaixing, chief steward of the Prince of Teng's household, and Palace Service Commissioner Alila to protect the Prince of Jinyuan; sent Tangkuo Ding, Left Xuanhui Commissioner, to present sacrifices; and ordered Consort Tudan and the imperial grandsons to observe mourning according to Han custom.
units.literal: Shizong appointed Yongcheng, Prince of Bin, as Stay-behind of the Central Capital, and he came to supervise the mourning. Shizong sent Zaixing, chief steward of the Prince of Teng's household, and Palace Service Commissioner Alila to protect the Prince of Jinyuan; sent Tangkuo Ding, Left Xuanhui Commissioner, to present sacrifices; and ordered Consort Tudan and all the imperial grandsons to observe mourning according to Han custom.

units.zh: 帝王儲位久，恩德在人者深，每日三時哭臨，侍衛軍士皆爭入臨，伏哭于承華殿下，聲殷如雷。
units.en: Long heir to the throne, his kindness ran deep; thrice daily they mourned him, and guards crowded below Chenghua Hall, weeping prostrate till the sound rolled like thunder.
units.literal: The emperor had long held the heir’s place and his kindness ran deep among the people; three times daily he was mourned, and guard soldiers crowded in to weep, prostrate below Chenghua Hall till the sound rolled like thunder.

units.zh: 中都百姓市門巷端為位慟哭。
units.en: Central Capital commoners set mourning seats at markets and lanes and wailed.
units.literal: Commoners of the Central Capital set mourning seats at market gates and lane ends and wailed.

units.zh: 七月壬午朔，賜諡宣孝太子。
units.en: In the seventh month, on the renwu new moon, he was given the posthumous title Xuanxiao Crown Prince.
units.literal: Seventh month, on renwu new moon: posthumous title Xuanxiao Crown Prince was granted.

units.zh: 九月庚寅，殯于南園熙春殿。
units.en: In the ninth month, on gengyin, the coffin was placed in the Southern Garden’s Xichun Hall.
units.literal: Ninth month, on gengyin, the coffin was placed in Xichun Hall of the Southern Garden.

units.zh: 己酉，世宗至自上京，未入國門，先至熙春殿致奠，慟哭久之。
units.en: On jiyou Shizong came from the Upper Capital; before the gate he went first to Xichun Hall to mourn and wept long.
units.literal: On jiyou Shizong arrived from the Upper Capital; before entering the gate he first went to Xichun Hall to offer mourning and wept long.

units.zh: 比葬，親臨者六。
units.en: By burial he had come in person six times.
units.literal: By burial he had come in person six times.

units.zh: 帝事世宗，凡巡幸西京、涼陘，及上陵、祭廟、謁衍慶宮，田獵觀稼，拜天射柳，未嘗去左右。
units.en: Serving Shizong on tours to the Western Capital and Liang Pass, tomb rites, temple sacrifices, Yanqing audiences, hunts, crop inspection, Heaven worship, and willow-shooting, he never left his side.
units.literal: In serving Shizong — on tours to the Western Capital and Liang Pass, on tomb visits, temple sacrifices, audiences at Yanqing Palace, hunts, crop inspection, Heaven worship, and willow-shooting — he never left his side.

units.zh: 上有事於圓丘，及親享於太廟，則行亞獻禮，不親祀則攝行祀事。
units.en: When the sovereign sacrificed at the Round Mound or the Imperial Temple, he performed the secondary offering; when the sovereign did not attend, he acted as surrogate.
units.literal: When the sovereign offered at the Round Mound or personally sacrificed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, he performed the secondary offering; when the sovereign did not sacrifice in person, he performed the rites as surrogate.

units.zh: 國有大慶則率百官上表賀。
units.en: On great celebrations he led the hundred officials in congratulatory memorials.
units.literal: On great state celebrations he led the hundred officials in congratulatory memorials.

units.zh: 正旦、萬春節則總班上壽。
units.en: At New Year and the Wan Spring Festival he led the court in offering longevity.
units.literal: At New Year and the Wan Spring Festival he presided over the court in offering longevity wishes.

units.zh: 冬十月庚戌朔，宰相以下朝見于慶和殿，太尉完顏守道上壽，世宗追悼悽愴者久之。
units.en: In winter, the tenth month, on the gengxu new moon, chancellors and below attended at Qinghe Hall; Grand Marshal Wanyan Shoudao offered longevity; Shizong mourned long in deep sorrow.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, on gengxu new moon: chancellors and below attended audience at Qinghe Hall; Grand Marshal Wanyan Shoudao offered longevity wishes; Shizong mourned in deep sorrow long.

units.zh: 十一月甲申，靈駕發引，世宗路祭於都城之西。
units.en: In the eleventh month, on jiashen, the spirit carriage set out; Shizong sacrificed by the road west of the capital.
units.literal: Eleventh month, on jiashen, the spirit carriage set out; Shizong offered roadside sacrifice west of the capital.

units.zh: 庚寅，葬於大房山。
units.en: On gengyin he was buried at Mount Dafang.
units.literal: On gengyin he was buried at Mount Dafang.

units.zh: 世宗欲加帝號，以問群臣，翰林修撰趙可對曰：「唐高宗追諡太子弘為孝敬皇帝。」
units.en: Shizong wished to add an imperial title and asked the ministers; Hanlin reviser Zhao Ke said: "Tang Gaozong made Prince Hong posthumously the Filial and Respectful Emperor."
units.literal: Shizong wished to add an imperial title and asked the ministers; Hanlin reviser Zhao Ke replied: "Tang Gaozong posthumously titled Prince Hong as Filial and Respectful Emperor."

units.zh: 左丞張汝弼曰：「此蓋出於武后。」
units.en: Left Vice Director Zhang Rubi said: "That came from Empress Wu."
units.literal: Left Vice Director Zhang Rubi said: "That surely came from Empress Wu."

units.zh: 遂止，乃建廟于衍慶宮後，祭和三獻，樂用登歌。
units.en: The plan was dropped; a temple was built behind Yanqing Palace with three offerings and ascension hymn music.
units.literal: The plan was dropped; a temple was built behind Yanqing Palace with three offerings and the ascension hymn for music.

units.zh: 二十六年，立子璟為皇太孫。
units.en: In the twenty-sixth year his son Jing was made imperial great-grandson.
units.literal: Twenty-sixth year: his son Jing was made imperial great-grandson.

units.zh: 二十九年，世宗崩。
units.en: In the twenty-ninth year Shizong died.
units.literal: Twenty-ninth year: Shizong died.

units.zh: 太孫即位，是為章宗。
units.en: The imperial great-grandson succeeded — Zhangzong.
units.literal: The imperial great-grandson succeeded — this is Zhangzong.

units.zh: 五月甲午，追諡體弘仁英文睿德光孝皇帝，廟號顯宗。
units.en: In the fifth month, on jiawu, he received the posthumous title Explicating Benevolence, Cultured and Civil, Sagacious and Virtuous, Bright and Filial Emperor and temple name Xianzong.
units.literal: Fifth month, on jiawu: posthumous title Explicating Benevolence, Cultured and Civil, Sagacious and Virtuous, Bright and Filial Emperor; temple name Xianzong.

units.zh: 丁酉，祔於太廟，陵曰裕陵。
units.en: On dingyou he was enshrined in the Imperial Temple; his tomb is Yuling.
units.literal: On dingyou he was enshrined in the Imperial Temple; tomb name Yuling.

units.zh: 帝天性仁厚，不忍刑殺。
units.en: By nature he was humane and could not bear punishments and executions.
units.literal: The emperor was by nature humane and could not bear punishments and executions.

units.zh: 梁檀兒盜金銀葉，憐其母老，李福興盜段匹，值坤厚陵禮成，家令本把盜銀器，值萬春節，皆委曲全活之。
units.en: Liang Tan'er stole gold and silver leaf — he pitied her aged mother; Li Fuxing stole silk — it was when Kunhou Tomb rites ended; Household Chief Benba stole silverware — it was Wan Spring Festival: each time he found grounds and spared them.
units.literal: Liang Tan'er stole gold and silver leaf — he pitied her aged mother; Li Fuxing stole bolts of silk — it fell when Kunhou Tomb rites were completed; Household Chief Benba stole silver vessels — it fell on the Wan Spring Festival: in each case he found grounds and spared their lives entirely.

units.zh: 亡失物者，責其償而不加罪。
units.en: When property was lost he made those responsible for the loss pay compensation but imposed no further penalty.
units.literal: Those who lost property were required to compensate for it but incurred no further penalty.

units.zh: 聞四方饑饉，輒先奏，加賑贍。
units.en: Hearing of famine anywhere, he reported it first and increased relief.
units.literal: Hearing of famine anywhere he reported it first and increased relief.

units.zh: 因田獵出巡，所過問民間疾苦。
units.en: On hunts and tours he asked after the people’s hardships.
units.literal: On hunts and tours he asked everywhere after the people’s hardships.

units.zh: 敬禮大臣，友愛兄弟。
units.en: He respected great ministers and was affectionate toward his brothers.
units.literal: He respected great ministers and was affectionate with his brothers.

units.zh: 葬明德皇后于坤厚陵，諸妃皆祔，自磐甯宮發引，趙王惟中以其母挽車先發，令張黃蓋者前行，帝呼執蓋者不應，少府監張僅言欲奏其事，帝止之。
units.en: When Empress Mingde was buried in Kunhou Mausoleum, all the consorts were buried alongside her. As the procession departed Panning Palace, Weizhong, Prince of Zhao, had his mother's funeral carriage set out first and ordered the yellow-canopy bearers to walk ahead. The emperor called to the canopy bearers, but they did not answer. Junior Palace Steward Zhang Jinyan wished to memorialize the matter, but the emperor stopped him.
units.literal: When Empress Mingde was buried in Kunhou Mausoleum, all the consorts were buried alongside her. As the procession departed Panning Palace, Weizhong, Prince of Zhao, had his mother's funeral carriage set out first and ordered the yellow-canopy bearers to walk ahead. The emperor called to the canopy bearers, but they did not answer. Junior Palace Steward Zhang Jinyan wished to memorialize the matter, but the emperor stopped him.

units.zh: 嘗作《重光座銘》，及刻座右銘於小玉碑，並刻其碑陰，皆深有理致。
units.en: He wrote an inscription for the Seat of Double Radiance and carved seat inscriptions on a small jade tablet, including the reverse — all deeply reasoned.
units.literal: He once composed an inscription for the Seat of Double Radiance and carved a seat inscription on a small jade tablet, also carving the reverse — all with deep reason.

units.zh: 最善射而不殫物，嘗奉詔拜陵，先獵，射一鹿獲之，即命罷獵，曰：「足奉祀事，焉用多殺？」
units.en: He excelled at archery but did not kill wantonly; ordered to worship at a tomb he hunted first, took one deer, then ended the hunt, saying: "That suffices for the rite — why kill more?"
units.literal: He excelled at archery but did not kill wantonly; once under edict to worship at a tomb he hunted first, shot one deer and took it, then ordered the hunt ended, saying: "That is enough for the sacrifice — why kill more?"

units.zh: 好生蓋其天性雲。
units.en: Cherishing life was truly his nature.
units.literal: Cherishing life was his nature indeed.

units.zh: 贊曰：遼王杲取中京，宗翰、宗望皆從，景宣別領合紮猛安。
units.en: Appraisal: Gao, Prince of Liao, captured the Central Capital; Zonghan and Zongwang both followed him, while Jingxuan separately commanded the hezha meng'an.
units.literal: Appraisal: Gao, Prince of Liao, captured the Central Capital; Zonghan and Zongwang both followed him, while Jingxuan separately commanded the hezha meng'an.

units.zh: 合紮猛安者，太祖之猛安也。
units.en: The hezha meng'an were Taizu's meng'an.
units.literal: Hezha meng'an were the Taizu's meng'an.

units.zh: 宗翰請立熙宗，宗幹不敢違，太宗不能拒，其義正，其理直矣。
units.en: Zonghan urged enthroning Xizong; Zonggan dared not refuse and Taizong could not reject — right in principle and just in grounds.
units.literal: Zonghan asked to enthrone Xizong; Zonggan dared not refuse and Taizong could not reject — the principle was upright and the grounds just.

units.zh: 舊史稱睿宗寬恕好施惠，熙宗不終，海陵隕斃，自時厥後，得大位者皆其子孫，有以夫。
units.en: Old histories call Ruizong forgiving and generous; Xizong did not last, Hailing died violently — thereafter the great throne passed only to his line; there was reason in it.
units.literal: The old histories say Ruizong was forgiving and fond of bestowing favor; Xizong did not last, Hailing fell by violence — after that those who gained the great throne were all his descendants; there was reason in it.

units.zh: 顯宗孝友惇睦，在東宮二十五年，不聞有過。
units.en: Xianzong was filial, friendly, and harmonious — twenty-five years in the Eastern Palace without a fault on record.
units.literal: Xianzong was filial, friendly, and harmonious; twenty-five years in the Eastern Palace without a fault heard.

units.zh: 承意開導，四方陰受其賜。
units.en: Carrying out his intent and guiding others, the four quarters quietly received his bounty.
units.literal: Carrying out his intent and guiding others, the four quarters quietly received his bounty.

units.zh: 天下不假之年，惜哉！
units.en: Heaven did not grant him years — alas!
units.literal: Heaven did not grant him years — alas!

units.zh: 於是，以秦王宗翰同子房配武成王，而降管仲以下。
units.en: Thereupon Prince of Qin Zonghan was paired with Zifang to accompany the Martial Accomplished King, while Guan Zhong and those below were demoted.
units.literal: Thereupon Prince of Qin Zonghan was paired with Zifang to accompany the Martial Accomplished King, while Guan Zhong and those below were demoted.

units.zh: 其祭，武成王、宗翰、子房各羊一、豕一，餘共用羊八，無豕。
units.en: At the sacrifice, the Martial Accomplished King, Zonghan, and Zifang each received one sheep and one pig; the remainder shared eight sheep in all, with no pigs.
units.literal: At the sacrifice, the Martial Accomplished King, Zonghan, and Zifang each had one sheep and one pig; the rest shared eight sheep in all, with no pigs.

units.zh: 七年，完顏匡等言：「我朝創業功臣，禮宜配祀。」
units.en: In the seventh year, Wanyan Kuang and others said: "The founding meritocrats of our dynasty ought by ritual to receive collateral sacrifice."
units.literal: In the seventh year, Wanyan Kuang and others said: "The founding meritocrats of our dynasty ought by ritual to receive collateral sacrifice."

units.zh: 洪惟世宗，功昭列聖，亦越顯考，德利生民。
units.en: Great was Emperor Shizong, his merit manifest to the successive sages; also surpassing was my illustrious father, whose virtue benefited the living people.
units.literal: Great was Emperor Shizong, his merit manifest to the successive sages; also surpassing was my illustrious father, whose virtue benefited the living people.

units.zh: 皇統元年正月二日，太師宗幹率百僚上表，請上皇帝尊號，凡三請，詔允。
units.en: On the second day of the first month of Huangtong 1, Grand Preceptor Zonggan led the entire court in a memorial asking that the emperor accept an honorific title. After three formal petitions, the throne assented.
units.literal: On the second day of the first month of the first year of Huangtong, Grand Preceptor Zonggan led the hundred officials in submitting a memorial requesting that the emperor be given an honorific title; they petitioned three times, and an edict granted consent.

units.zh: 十日，帝服袞冕禦元和殿，宗幹率百僚恭奉冊禮。
units.en: On the tenth day the emperor, robed in full ceremonial dress, took his seat in the Yuanhe Hall while Zonggan led the court in presenting the investiture ceremony.
units.literal: On the tenth day, the emperor, wearing dragon robes and the imperial cap, took the throne in the Yuanhe Hall; Zonggan led the hundred officials in reverently presenting the investiture rites.

units.zh: 冊文云云，「臣等謹奉玉冊、玉寶，上尊號曰崇天體道欽明文武聖德皇帝」。
units.en: The investiture text declared, in substance: "We your subjects respectfully present the jade book and jade seal, offering the honorific title Sagely Emperor Who Reveres Heaven, Embodies the Way, and Is Illustrious in Civil and Martial Virtue."
units.literal: The text of the investiture document read, in effect: "We your subjects respectfully present the jade book and jade seal, offering the honorific title Sagely Emperor Who Reveres Heaven, Embodies the Way, and Is Illustrious in Civil and Martial Virtue."

units.zh: 大定十一年，將有事於南郊，朝享太廟，右丞石琚奏其禮，上曰：「前朝漢人祭天，惟務整肅儀仗，此自奉耳，非敬天也。
units.en: In Dading 11 (1171), as the court prepared for the Southern Suburb sacrifice and an offering at the Grand Ancestral Temple, Right Vice Councillor Shi Jue presented the ritual program. The emperor said, "Under the previous dynasty, the Han worshiped Heaven by striving only to make the ceremonial escort imposing. That was self-display, not reverence for Heaven.
units.literal: In the eleventh year of Dading, when rites were to be performed at the Southern Suburb and the emperor was to offer at the Grand Ancestral Temple, Right Vice Councillor Shi Jue presented the ritual program. The emperor said: "In the previous dynasty the Han people worshiped Heaven by striving only to make the ceremonial guard imposing. That was self-display, not reverence for Heaven.
